title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1972-08-21
source: Source: SBD > Master Reels @ 7.5ips (10 Inch half-track ) > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Recorded by Betty Cantor-Jackson, provided by Charlie Miller; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 . wav 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick October 2017

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording capturing a classic, vintage performance highlighted by a stellar China‑Rider, Smoking Playing in the Band, a dreamy Stella Blue and a magical Dark Star‑El Paso.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this under‑appreciated show, calling it a flawless, full‑stride performance with every instrument firing on all cylinders. The Miller/SirMick soundboard master is praised as crystal‑clear and arguably the best it has ever sounded, making the standout sequences – China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Playing in the Band, Stella Blue, and Dark Star > El Paso – truly shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are 5‑star and focus on exceptional musical moments plus a superb soundboard master, indicating a top‑tier show and recording despite the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller/SirMick mastering is described as never sounding better; reviewers note crisp, clear sound with no reported issues.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the set as a vintage, classic performance with seamless transitions and the band firing on all cylinders throughout.
